ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the attached figure there is a rectangle, with vertex A at the upper left, C at the upper right, D at the lower right, and E at the lower left. Point B is located on the upper side AC, and point F is located on the left side AE; the figure draws the line segments BD and FD, so the boundary of quadrilateral ABDF is A-B-D-F-A. Then reason: it is known that AC=32, AE=20, and B and F are respectively the midpoints of AC and AE. According to the method, set coordinates A=(0,0), C=(32,0), E=(0,20), D=(32,20). Because B is the midpoint of AC, B=(16,0); because F is the midpoint of AE, F=(0,10). Use the shoelace formula to calculate the area of polygon A-B-D-F: area = 1/2 |(0·0 + 16·20 + 32·10 + 0·0) - (0·16 + 0·32 + 20·0 + 10·0)| = 1/2 |640 - 0| = 320.
